description:
You are assisting a backup administrator in preparing a summary of archived file types before moving backups to long-term storage. You are given a text file at /home/user/archive/file_list.txt containing one filename per line (with file extensions, e.g. data.csv, report.pdf, image.jpg). Your goal is to produce a frequency report of each file extension found in this list. Specifically: 1. Extract just the file extension from each filename (text after the last dot). 2. Count how many times each file extension appears in the list. 3. Sort the results alphabetically by file extension. 4. Output the final frequency report to /home/user/archive/extension_report.txt. This file must be formatted as follows:
  • One line per file extension.
  • Each line must be in the format: <extension> <count> (for example: csv 5).
  • Lines must be sorted alphabetically by the extension.
Once you have completed the task, you can inspect the contents of /home/user/archive/extension_report.txt to verify the results.
truth: Before the task starts, the following file exists: /home/user/archive/file_list.txt with the following contents: data.csv report.pdf notes.txt data.csv image.jpg slides.pdf archive.zip notes.txt data.csv photo.jpg backup.zip After correct execution, the frequency report file must exist as: /home/user/archive/extension_report.txt with the following exact contents: csv 3 jpg 2 pdf 2 txt 2 zip 2 The directory /home/user/archive/ exists and is writable by the agent.
